page.overview:
Who is ????

??? is a non-playable Legendary Duelist in Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Links. This is a video game depiction of Grady, a character from the anime Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's. He cannot be unlocked, only appearing as an opponent in the Duelist Chronicles 5D's: Attack of the Dark Signers! event.
